description: This file defines the UsageCacheManager class responsible for managing usage and subscription data caching, including interactions with Redis and Stripe APIs.

classes.name: UsageCacheManager
classes.description: Manages caching of subscription details and quotas, interacts with Redis and Stripe APIs, implements singleton pattern.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of UsageCacheManager, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the cache, setting up Redis connection if in QUEUE mode.

methods.name: getSubscriptionDetails
methods.description: Retrieves subscription details, using cache or Stripe API.

methods.name: getQuotas
methods.description: Retrieves quota information for a subscription, using cache or Stripe API.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Generic method to get a value from cache by key.

methods.name: getTTL
methods.description: Gets time-to-live for a cache key.

methods.name: mget
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache values by keys.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a cache key with value and optional TTL.
